One curriculum, one evidence trail

Schedule · Searchable catalog · Source coverage

140 study days · 15 projects · 80 coding questions · 21 hours per week

Catalog 3.0-unified. 100 ai · 100 career · 4 checkpoint · 140 dsa · 39 exercise · 744 lesson · 45 milestone · 29 navigation · 63 paper · 15 project · 1 reference · 100 systems · 904 topic · 16 update

Basic ML and deep learning remain theory. Projects use pretrained models and existing libraries. Public course titles identify coverage; study objectives are independently written. Optional references fit inside the listed blocks.

Source coverage

42 captured public pages · 1727 metadata entries · 1556 unique source items. Repeated links can appear in several directories and course outlines.

Directory captures may be incomplete where pagination, filters or access limits apply. Mathematics roadmap placeholders and advertised totals can differ from the named public steps; generic or hidden labels are retained as coverage notes and do not become invented lessons or extra assignments. Announced courses remain unavailable until readable material exists.
